name: Gbam
description: Pepe at a podium grinning, caption 'Gbam'. Nigerian 'exactly / na so / mic drop' — the point just landed.
whenToUse: Send when someone said the truth, finished a sharp point, or you agree hard: gbam, exactly, na so, facts, period, 'that's it', a roast that landed, or a conclusion. Also after a clean answer the user will feel. Playful emphasis, not anger.
whenNotToUse: Skip greetings, apologies, confusion, or when you disagree. Do not use it to shut someone down meanly.
